<!-- pr-reviewer: ff85436bc97a119f881c0bcc69490e24bac54f52 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

### What looks good
- Everything Is a Command: the UI row edits the draft `op_ui.params` (`approach_page.rs:102`, the same `num` pattern as "Height above material"). The change goes to the document through `EditOperationParams`. MCP uses the same params door. The undo and redo pin passes.
- The default writes no key. `approach_to_dto` uses `num(a.approach_distance, d.approach_distance)` (`project/approach.rs:130`). A file without the key loads `DEFAULT_APPROACH_DISTANCE`. No format bump is necessary, and the change is not breaking.
- Digest: bytes `0xCA` + value are written only when the value is not the default (`digest.rs:230`). Each earlier operation keeps its digest. No generator in `crates/motion/src` or `crates/app/src` reads `approach_distance`, and no code selects a path by `Approach` equality. Thus the stamp change can only cause a regeneration. It cannot change a move. No posted G-code changes, and the PR changes no file in `tests/golden/`.
- Validation at command creation: `Approach::validate` calls `approach_distance_refusal` (`motion/src/approach.rs:333`), and `named_refusal` gives the message by name (`sane.rs:78`). `CreateOperation`, `EditOperationParams` and the project load (`project/validate.rs:295`) all use `named_refusal`.
- UI text: the label "Approach distance" and the hover text are plain English, with the same style as the other `prop_row_hint` rows. The row shows only for Inside and Outside on 2D Offset, 2D Pocket and 2D Adaptive.
- MCP and skill row: `links.approach.approach_distance`, default 2.0 mm, the key is absent at the default, zero is legal, negative is refused. The skill row and the DTO agree.
- `Process change: yes` is present. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3745`. The PR changes no snapshot PNG.
- The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` is 1710 on main and 1711 on the merged tree.

### Results merged with main (locally, main at `7868d3786`)
The trial merge with `origin/main` is clean. `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`, `-j 6`.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| `app --test mcp mcp_approach_distance` (4 pins) | 4 passed |
| `app --test lead_approach` (stamp pin included) | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`), `pass_start::the_leads_tab_shows_the_approach_distance_only_for_inside_and_outside` included | 1531 passed, 8 ignored |
| `camcraft-motion --lib` | 587 passed, 22 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean (only the workspace manifest warning `unused workspace dependency truck-polymesh`, which comes from main) |

The full quick plan and unfiltered app tests were not run, by the order of the dispatcher.

### Heavy lanes
`cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main --dry-run` reaches `app heavy: every target` (`digest.rs`) and `motion heavy: every target` (`motion/src/approach.rs`). **Not run**, by the standing order (heavy lanes at the cut). This is not a pass. The value has no reader, so the toolpaths of these lanes cannot change. The cut gate is the check.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `APPROACH_DISTANCE_REFUSAL` (`motion/src/approach.rs:229`) says "must be zero or a positive length in mm". The check also refuses a value above 10 000 mm. For such a value, the message does not tell the cause. Possible fix: add "of at most 10 m" to the text. This is a P7 follow-up.
2. The UI row and the skill row describe a behaviour that comes with #3746. Until #3746 merges, a change of the value changes no move. The skill row says so; the UI tooltip does not. This is acceptable for one slice of #3741, if #3746 ships in the same cut.
3. File size: `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs` is 1394 lines (+4), `crates/motion/src/approach.rs` is 473 (+27), `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs` is 418 (+1). These files were already above 400 lines. Not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
